audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp gas calculation safe from integer overflow?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ModExp precompile gas calculation is an Execution Layer (EL) concern. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement ModExp gas computation. No relevant code found in target codebase.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are EIP-7825 and EIP-7883 activated simultaneously at Fusaka fork?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7825 (gas cap) and EIP-7883 (ModExp repricing) are Execution Layer EIPs. Prysm manages CL fork schedule (Phase0/Altair/Bellatrix/Capella/Deneb/Electra/Fulu) but does not control EL EIP activation. config/params/config.go:InitializeForkSchedule manages CL forks only.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do MEV-Boost relays validate gas cap for submitted blocks?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: MEV-Boost relay validation is handled by external relay software (e.g., mev-boost-relay), not by Prysm. Prysm interacts with builders/relays via the builder API but does not implement relay-side validation logic.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does block validation catch private channel txpool bypasses?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Private transaction channels (Flashbots Protect) and txpool validation are Execution Layer concerns. Prysm as a CL client does not manage the transaction pool or validate individual transaction gas limits.

audit_items.title: Verify Pre-Condition: Is ceiling division used in multiplication_complexity for words?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ModExp multiplication_complexity word calculation is an EL precompile implementation detail. Prysm does not implement EVM precompiles. No ModExp-related code found in target codebase.

audit_items.title: Verify Post-Condition: Is iteration_count = bit_length(exponent) - 1 for small non-zero exponents?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ModExp iteration_count and exponent bit_length computation are EL precompile implementation details. Prysm does not implement EVM precompiles.

audit_items.title: Verify Post-Condition: Is bit_length of top 32 bytes computed correctly for large exponents?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ModExp exponent bit_length computation for large exponents is an EL precompile implementation detail. Prysm does not implement EVM precompiles.

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: Is ModExp gas computation using only integer arithmetic (no floating-point)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ModExp gas computation arithmetic type verification is an EL concern. Prysm does not implement ModExp gas calculation.

audit_items.title: Verify Pre-Condition: Is gas cap check on raw tx.gasLimit, not derived values?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Transaction gas cap validation on raw tx.gasLimit is an EL txpool concern. Prysm passes GasLimit through execution payload structures (proto/engine/v1/execution_engine.pb.go) but does not validate individual transaction gas limits. GasLimit in Prysm is a block-level execution payload field, not per-transaction.

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: Is ModExp gas cost monotonically non-decreasing with input size?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ModExp gas cost monotonicity verification is an EL precompile concern. Prysm does not implement ModExp gas calculation.

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: Is EIP-7883 gas cost >= EIP-2565 gas cost for all inputs?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7883 vs EIP-2565 ModExp gas cost comparison is an EL precompile concern. Prysm does not implement ModExp gas calculation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ECDSA signature recovery correctly deriving sender addresses?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ECDSA transaction signature recovery (recover_sender) is an EL concern. Prysm uses ECDSA only for P2P networking (libp2p key management in crypto/ecdsa/), not for Ethereum transaction sender recovery. secp256k1 is used via external go-ethereum dependency for P2P, not for tx validation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the ECDSA r-component range validation enforced?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ECDSA r-component range validation (0 < r < SECP256K1N) is an EL transaction validation concern. Prysm does not perform ECDSA signature validation on Ethereum transactions.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-2 low-s normalization enforced?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-2 low-s normalization for transaction malleability prevention is an EL transaction validation concern. Prysm does not validate Ethereum transaction signatures.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are transaction type signing hashes non-colliding?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Transaction type signing hash collision prevention is an EL concern. Prysm does not process or validate Ethereum transaction type signatures.

audit_items.title: Verify Conditional Scope: Pre-EIP-155 cross-chain replay vulnerability awareness
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-155 chain ID replay protection is an EL transaction signing concern. Prysm does not handle Ethereum transaction signing or chain ID validation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does snapshot mechanism provide true deep-copy isolation?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM state snapshot mechanism (copy_trie, _main_trie, _storage_tries, begin_transaction/rollback_transaction) is an EL state management concern. Prysm manages beacon state, not EVM execution state.

audit_items.title: Is the snapshot count invariant maintained after begin_transaction?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM snapshot count invariant (state._snapshots, begin_transaction) is an EL state management concern. Prysm does not implement EVM state snapshots.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does commit_transaction correctly decrement snapshot count?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM commit_transaction and snapshot stack management is an EL state management concern. Prysm does not implement EVM transaction commit/rollback.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is created_accounts cleared only at outermost snapshot pop?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM created_accounts tracking (EIP-2200 gas accounting, EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT) is an EL state management concern. Prysm does not track EVM account creation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does rollback_transaction restore exact snapshot state?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM rollback_transaction state restoration (REVERT/out-of-gas, _main_trie, _storage_tries) is an EL state management concern. Prysm does not implement EVM state rollback.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is transient storage correctly restored after rollback?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM transient storage rollback (EIP-1153 TSTORE/TLOAD) is an EL state management concern. No transient_storage implementation found in Prysm. Prysm does not implement EVM opcodes.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are persistent and transient snapshot stacks synchronized?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM persistent/transient snapshot stack synchronization is an EL state management concern. Prysm does not implement EVM state snapshot stacks.

audit_items.title: Is get_account guaranteed to never return None?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM get_account null-safety (EMPTY_ACCOUNT default) is an EL state management concern. Prysm does not implement EVM account retrieval.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does set_account(None) preserve storage?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EVM set_account(None) storage preservation is an EL state management concern. Prysm does not implement EVM account state operations.
